documents.text: Ariana. requirement. Arianna, Rune of Compassion, Compassion rune, Ariana permission requirement, RUNE conversation. Meet Ariana at the Conservatory and ask for the RUNE. She needs her mother Anya's permission.

Anya. method. mother permission, Anya permission, Compassion permission, Anya permission conversation, Blue Boar Tavern, RUNE PERMISSION YES. Visit Anya at the Blue Boar Tavern, mention RUNE or PERMISSION, and answer YES when asked.
Ariana. acquisition. Arianna, Rune of Compassion, Compassion rune, Ariana permission confirmation. Return to Ariana, confirm permission, and receive the Rune of Compassion.
Shrine of Compassion. method. Compassion mantra, MU. Cleanse the southern shrine using the rune, chant MU, take the Moonstone, and meditate.
Manrel. acquisition. Beyvin key, Honesty key. Find Manrel south of the Blue Bottle Inn; ask for the KEY and vow to place flowers on Beyvin's coffin.
Blue Bottle Inn. location. catacombs, secret door, Blue Bottle storeroom secret door. Search the inn storeroom wall for the secret door into the catacombs.
Beyvin. method. Rune of Honesty, Honesty rune, Beyvin tomb, Beyvin tomb flowers, Manrel key use. Unlock Beyvin's tomb with Manrel's key, take the rune, and leave flowers before departing.
Shrine of Honesty. method. Honesty mantra, AHM. Use the rune at the Shrine of Honesty on Verity Isle, chant AHM, and recover the Moonstone.
Sherry. recruitment. mouse recruitment, Sherry cheese, Sherry recruitment cheese. In Castle Britannia's kitchen, pick up cheese, offer it to Sherry, and invite her to JOIN.
Sherry. location. Sword and Keg, Valor mouse hole, Sherry solo control, Jhelom mouse hole. Travel to the Sword and Keg in Jhelom, position Sherry at the mouse hole, and switch control to her.
Sherry. method. Rune of Valor, Valor rune, mouse hole, Sherry mouse hole retrieval. Enter the mouse hole as Sherry to grab the rune, then regroup with the party.
Shrine of Valor. method. Valor mantra, RA. Cleanse the Shrine of Valor atop the Serpent's Spine by chanting RA and taking the Moonstone.
Lenora. method. Mayor Lenora, Boskin permission, Boskin interrogation permission. Ask Mayor Lenora for PERMISSION to interrogate Boskin.
Pridgarm. acquisition. Yew jail key, Boskin kids, Pridgarm jail key, Boskin RUNE KIDS conversation. Collect the jail key from Pridgarm, then question Boskin about the RUNE and his KIDS.
Boskin. method. Boskin lie, Lenora kids, TRUTH, Boskin KIDS story, Lenora story verification. Verify with Lenora; she reveals the story is false. Confront Boskin with TRUTH to learn the hiding place.
Rune of Justice. acquisition. Justice rune, Slaughtered Lamb plant, Justice mantra. Retrieve the rune beneath the Slaughtered Lamb plant, chant BEH at the shrine, and return the jail key.

Panpipes. acquisition. Julia panpipes, Ben yew log, yew board, yew log board transformation, Panpipes crafting. Buy a yew log from Ben west of Yew, cut it into a board, and ask Julia to craft PANPIPES.
Gwenno. method. Stones tune, Stones song, 6789878767653, Gwenno STONES conversation, Stones numeric tune. Ask Gwenno about the song STONES to learn the numeric tune 6789878767653.
Selganor. method. Rune of Sacrifice, Sacrifice rune, Artisan Guild, Selganor Stones performance. Perform the tune for Selganor inside the Artisan Guild to receive the rune.
Shrine of Sacrifice. method. Sacrifice mantra, CAH. Cleanse the desert shrine with mantra CAH, gather the Moonstone, and meditate.
Whitsaber. acquisition. Mayor Whitsaber, Rune of Honor, Honor rune. Speak with Mayor Whitsaber about the RUNE; he lends it to you.
Rune of Honor. location. Honor rune, Trinsic pedestal, Honor rune pickup, central pedestal pickup. Take the rune from the central pedestal and promise to return it soon.

Rune of Honor. method. Honor rune, SUMM, Honor mantra, Honor rune return, return to pedestal, Honor shrine cleansing. Cleanse the shrine north of Trinsic with mantra SUMM, recover the Moonstone, then return the rune to the pedestal.
Whitsaber. outcome. virtue boost, Honor return, Whitsaber virtue reward. Report back to Whitsaber for a virtue boost.
Marney. method. POEM, BASKET, Spirituality rune, Marney POEM BASKET conversation. Use follow-up keywords POEM and BASKET to jog her memory.
Rune of Spirituality. location. Spirituality rune, hope chest, Marney hope chest search. Search the hope chest in Marney's house to obtain the rune.

Shrine of Spirituality. route. Spirituality Orb route, Ethereal Void shrine, red moongate. Reach the Shrine of Spirituality in the Ethereal Void: use the Orb of the Moons two tiles west and one tile south of the Avatar, then enter the red moongate. This route does not require waiting until midnight.

Shrine of Spirituality. route. Spirituality blue moongate, midnight moongate. Alternatively, enter a blue moongate at midnight. You can depart from any blue moongate; Skara Brae is only where you obtain the rune.
Shrine of Spirituality. method. Spirituality mantra, OM. At the shrine, use the Rune of Spirituality and chant OM to cleanse it, then take the moonstone.
Antonio. method. Mayor Antonio, Humility riddle. Ask Mayor Antonio about HUMILITY; he poses a riddle.
Conor. identity. humble soul, most humble villager. Question each villager with keyword HUMILITY until Conor is identified.
Rune of Humility. acquisition. Humility rune, CONOR. Answer CONOR when returning to Antonio to gain the rune.
Shrine of Humility. method. Humility mantra, LUM. Cleanse the Isle of the Avatar shrine by chanting LUM.
Mariah. method. Gargish book, Gargish tome, BOOK, Mariah BOOK conversation, Gargish tome delivery. Present the Gargish book to Mariah at the Lycaeum using keyword BOOK.

Silver Tablet. requirement. Mariah tablet, silver tablet half, Mariah gypsy lead, Trinsic gypsies, missing silver tablet half. She reveals her half of the silver tablet and sends you to the gypsies near Trinsic.
Gypsies. method. Zoltan, TABLET, Homer lead, gypsy TABLET conversation, Zoltan Homer lead. Ask the gypsy leader about the TABLET; they direct you to Homer in Buccaneer's Den.
Homer. requirement. HAWKINS, Homer guild, Homer HAWKINS conversation, Hawkins guild requirement. Speak with Homer about HAWKINS; he insists you join the guild.
Budo. requirement. Phoenix belt, Thieves Guild, guild initiation, Budo GUILD conversation, Phoenix belt request. Ask Budo about the GUILD; he requests Phoenix's belt from Castle Britannia's sewers.
Phoenix. method. Phoenix belt, invisibility pickpocket. Cast INVISIBILITY and PICKPOCKET Phoenix to steal the belt humanely.
Budo. outcome. guild password, Homer password, Phoenix belt return, Budo password reward. Return the belt to Budo to receive the guild password for Homer.
Ybarra. acquisition. Old Ybarra, Shame map piece. Trade food to Ybarra in Dungeon Shame for his map piece.
Dungeon Wrong. acquisition. Wrong map piece, Covetous map piece. Solve the Wrong/Covetous lever puzzle and search level three for another fragment.
Hawknose. acquisition. Ol Hawknose, Ant Mound map piece. Plunder the Ant Mound queen's chamber for Hawknose's body and map scrap.
Shipwreck. acquisition. shipwreck map piece, 71S 15E. Dive the shipwreck at 71S 15E, defeat the ghosts, and secure the stern piece.
Morchella. acquisition. magic shield trade, Morchella map piece. Trade Morchella east of Serpent's Hold a MAGIC SHIELD for her shard.
Bonn. acquisition. Dagger Isle map piece, Bonn harpsichord. Move Bonn's harpsichord on Dagger Isle to reveal a cellar ladder and fragment.
Arturos. acquisition. Arturos locket, Arturos map piece. Purchase (or steal) Arturos's locket north of Paws for the enclosed piece.
Whitsaber. acquisition. Gordon, Whitsaber alias, Whitsaber map piece. Expose Mayor Whitsaber's alias GORDON in Trinsic to obtain his portion.
Homer. acquisition. final map piece, eight map fragments, Hawkins map. Return to Homer with eight fragments; he gives the final piece and digging instructions.
Pirate Cave. route. Hawkins island, Homer directions. Sail to Hawkins's island southeast of Buccaneer's Den using Homer's directions.
Pirate Cave. method. THIS WAY, first sign. Ignore the first "THIS WAY" sign (go opposite), then follow later signs accurately.
Maze of Death. method. Pirate Cave maze, right wall. Survive the Maze of Death by hugging the right wall, disarming traps, and conserving powder kegs.
Pirate Cave. outcome. Silver Tablet, Storm Cloak return, Magic Fan. Collect the silver tablet, Storm Cloak, Magic Fan, and treasure. Return the Storm Cloak to Homer for a virtue reward.
Hythloth. route. Hythloth entry, sealed door, Shrine of Humility entrance. Enter Hythloth via the Shrine of Humility or powder-keg the sealed door on the Isle of the Avatar.
Hythloth. method. level 4, blocked tunnels. Descend to level 4, using PROTECTION spells and powder kegs for blocked tunnels.
Captain Johne. acquisition. Gargish scroll, vocabulary scroll, GARGISH. Locate Captain Johne's home, discuss GARGISH, and accept his vocabulary scroll.
Gargish Vocabulary Scroll. use. Gargish language, learn Gargish, vocabulary scroll. Immediately USE the scroll to gain fluency before exiting into the gargoyle realm.
Beh Lem. recruitment. safe passage, gargoyle escort. Outside Hythloth, speak with Beh Lem and ask him to JOIN to guarantee safe passage.
Draxinusom. method. SURRENDER, Lord Draxinusom. Enter the city, request an audience with Lord Draxinusom, and agree to SURRENDER.
Amulet of Submission. use. gargoyle trust, move freely. Wear the Amulet of Submission to move freely and earn gargoyle trust.
Balloon Plans. location. Sutek catacombs, 65S 52E. Recover the balloon plans from Sutek's catacombs at 65S 52E.
Cloth. acquisition. 40 spidersilk, Arbeth, Charlotte, silk thread. Gather 40 spidersilk, have Arbeth in Paws spin thread, and Charlotte in New Magincia weave cloth.
Silk Bag. acquisition. Marissa, Michelle, wicker basket, silk bag. Ask Marissa in Paws to sew the silk bag, and buy a wicker basket from Michelle in Minoc.

Hot-Air Balloon. method. balloon assembly, rope, large pot, Hot-Air Balloon final assembly, USE balloon plans, balloon components. Collect rope and a large pot for the burner, then USE the plans once all parts are in your inventory.

Gargoyle Principles. explanation. Control, Passion, Diligence, Mondain, Minax, Exodus, UN OR US, Gargoyle Principles mantras, Control Passion Diligence mantras. Visit the shrines of Control, Passion, and Diligence to obtain mantras UN, OR, and US from Mondain, Minax, and Exodus.
Shrine of Singularity. route. Singularity plateau, balloon shrine. Use the balloon to reach the plateaued Shrine of Singularity.
Shrine of Singularity. method. UNORUS, Sacred Quest. Chant UNORUS at the shrine to accept the Sacred Quest.
Stonegate. method. cyclops patriarch, 10N 37E. Travel to Stonegate (10N 37E) and greet the patriarch peacefully.
Vault Key. acquisition. fresh fish, HELP, cyclops fish. Catch a fresh fish nearby and present it when discussing HELP to earn the vault key.
Vortex Cube. location. cube chamber, Stonegate secret passages, Vortex Cube chamber, Stonegate lower floors. Navigate secret passages on the lower floors to reach the cube chamber.
Gargoyle Lens. acquisition. red lens, broken lens, Lor-wis-lem, Hall of Knowledge. Retrieve the broken red lens from the Hall of Knowledge and deliver it to Lor-wis-lem the lens grinder.
Britannian Lens. acquisition. blue lens, Ephemerides, glass sword lens. Take a glass sword to Ephemerides in Moonglow, discuss LENS and SWORD, and receive the blue Britannian lens.
Vortex Cube. requirement. eight Moonstones, charge cube, all moonstones, Vortex Cube charging, Moonstones loading. Place all eight Moonstones into the Vortex Cube before arriving at the Codex.

Twin Lenses. method. Britannian Lens placement, Gargoyle Lens placement, Codex lenses, left flame Britannian lens, right flame gargoyle lens. Set the Britannian lens between the left flame and the Codex, and the gargoyle lens between the right flame and the Codex.

Vortex Cube. method. Codex ritual, cross beams, use cube, Vortex Cube activation, Codex crossing beams. Position the charged cube in front of the Codex, ensure both beams cross the cube, then USE it to complete the ritual.

Merchants Circuit. method. The Merchants' Circuit, grain, flour, Linda, Grison, Cullen, grain flour trade route. Carry grain from Linda in Britain to Grison in Paws, then bring his flour back to Cullen in Britain.
Merchants Circuit. method. The Merchants' Circuit, wool trade, Aurendir wool, Charlotte wool buyer. Trade wool locally in New Magincia by buying from Aurendir and selling to Charlotte.

Merchants Circuit. method. The Merchants' Circuit, thread trade, empty honey jars, honey jars trade, Zeke Empath Abbey. Carry thread from Paws to Yew, or empty honey jars from Minoc to Zeke at Empath Abbey, for better margins.
Lycaeum Library Errands. method. Errands of the Lycaeum Library, The Wizard of Oz, Lord British book reward. Find The Wizard of Oz in the Lycaeum and give it to Lord British for twenty gems.

Lycaeum Library Errands. method. Errands of the Lycaeum Library, Snilwit's Big Book of Boardgame Strategy, Dr. Cat book reward. Bring Snilwit's Big Book of Boardgame Strategy to Dr. Cat in Paws for 150 gold.

Lycaeum Library Errands. method. Errands of the Lycaeum Library, The Lost Book of Mantras, Lost Book of Mantras, wisps book exchange, information substance choice. Offer The Lost Book of Mantras to the wisps near Empath Abbey; choose information for a finale clue or substance for gold nuggets.
Chuckles Trail. method. Chuckles' Trail of Clues, Chuckles Trail, Chuckles clue beginning, Nystul room chest, start clue hunt. Ask Chuckles about his clue, then search the chest in Nystul's room.

Chuckles Trail. method. Chuckles' Trail of Clues, Chuckles scroll route, clue hunt scrolls, Blue Bottle harpsichord clue, Yew jail beds clue. Follow the scrolls through a plant in Serpent's Hold, a beehive in Minoc, the Blue Bottle harpsichord, the Yew jail beds, and a New Magincia cauldron.

Chuckles Trail. method. Chuckles' Trail of Clues, Chuckles final clue, clue hunt finish, Smith final clue, Castle Britannia stone lions. Search the stone lions back at Castle Britannia, then visit Iolo's Hut and ask Smith for the final clue.

Swamp Cave. method. Explore the Swamp Cave, Swamp Cave preparation, swamp boots preparation, Telekinesis Vanish and Reappear. Equip every companion with swamp boots and prepare Telekinesis or Vanish and Reappear.

Swamp Cave. method. Explore the Swamp Cave, Swamp Cave coast route, Kafiristan Pass. Travel east from Britain, leave the Minoc road after Kafiristan Pass, then follow the coast to the cave at 0°N, 38°E.
Swamp Cave. method. Explore the Swamp Cave, Swamp Cave fourth level loot, dead mage treasure. Explore to the fourth level and search the dead mage for the Storm Cloak, magic wands, and rare rings.

Dungeon Deceit. method. Plunder Dungeon Deceit, Dungeon Deceit preparation, Xiao Reveal Vanish, Deceit ship. Bring a ship and learn Reveal and Vanish from Xiao before sailing east of the Shrine of Honesty.
Dungeon Deceit. method. Plunder Dungeon Deceit, Dungeon Deceit trap route, Reveal solo mode. Cast Reveal on entry, take the western route, and use solo mode in narrow passages to limit trap damage.

Dungeon Deceit. method. Plunder Dungeon Deceit, Dungeon Deceit fourth level treasure, northern bodies, southern gold cache. Search the northern fourth-level bodies for rare rings, then brave the southern route for the gold-nugget cache.

Dungeon Despise. method. Despise and the Heroes' Hole, Dungeon Despise entrance, Despise entrance route, central valley entrance. Follow the mountain pass northeast of Castle Britannia to the dungeon entrance hidden in the central valley.

Dungeon Despise. method. Despise and the Heroes' Hole, Dungeon Despise lake, Despise lake route, eastern ladder underground lake. Trace the gold-nugget path, then take the eastern ladder to the underground lake and its guarded stores.

Heroes' Hole. method. Despise and the Heroes' Hole, Heroes' Hole optional exploration, Despise Heroes Hole connection. Continue east from the first floor into the Heroes' Hole when you want combat experience; the connected cave holds no essential quest item.
Silver Tablet. requirement. Silver Tablet requirement, Mariah other half. Mariah: say BOOK → needs other half.
Ariana. method. Ariana PERMISSION YES conversation. Ariana: say PERMISSION → answer YES to claim the rune.
Sherry. method. Sherry dismissal, Castle Britannia karma. Virtue: dismiss Sherry later at Castle Britannia to avoid karma loss.
Hope Chest. location. Marney chest northern bedroom. House: hope chest in northern bedroom.
Gypsies. method. Zoltan TABLET conversation. Zoltan: say TABLET for Homer lead.
Dungeon Wrong. method. Wrong lever order, 4-1-2-3 lever sequence. Wrong: flip levers in order 4-1-2-3.
Arturos Locket. acquisition. Arturos haggling, 50 gold locket, Arturos pickpocket. Arturos: haggle down to 50 gold or pickpocket.
Maze of Death. method. WIZARD EYE, DISPEL FIELD, Maze spell options. Maze: use WIZARD EYE or DISPEL FIELD.
Captain Johne. acquisition. Johne LANGUAGE conversation, GARGISH LANGUAGE scroll. Johne: say GARGISH/LANGUAGE for the scroll.
Draxinusom. acquisition. Amulet of Submission SURRENDER, Draxinusom amulet reward. Draxinusom: accept with SURRENDER to receive the amulet.
Shrine of Control. explanation. control mantra, UN. Control: mantra UN.
Shrine of Passion. explanation. passion mantra, OR. Passion: mantra OR.
Shrine of Diligence. explanation. diligence mantra, US. Diligence: mantra US.
Stonegate Vault. location. Stonegate B2 hidden door, north wall vault door. Vault: hidden door on B2 north wall.
Lor-wis-lem. method. Lor-wis-lem LENS conversation, red lens repair keyword. Lor-wis-lem: say LENS for repairs.
Headless production method. explanation. headless production, headlesses produced. Wizard
Tangle vine sleep-inducing part. explanation. tangle vine sleep, sleep-inducing part of tangle vine, tangle vine pods. Pods
Sulfurous Ash origin. explanation. source of Sulfurous Ash, Sulfurous Ash source. Volcanic Eruptions
